challenge.results: The named witness contains both the combined-work lead-in and the independent-module grant. It defines independence by absence of derivation from or basis on this library, and requires compliance with each linked module’s license. An abbreviated usage cannot establish that full sequence. The different Free Pascal lead-in and LGPL base do not identify this GPL notice. An OpenJDK Assembly Exception designation does not establish the notice in GNU Classpath 0.95.
